name: The Road Breaker
description: the biggest brimstone demon on the Cracked Road: a colossal hulking demon of black basalt with blazing orange seams, huge shoulders, small horned head, wielding a broken slab of road with iron rebar sticking out of it as a club

poses.stand: standing hunched, the road-slab club resting on one huge shoulder
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands, breathing heavily, tapping the club on his palm

attack.action: raises the road-slab club high and smashes it down on the ground in front of him to the right, cracks of orange light shooting out

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
